decisions.reason: The garage door operator line remains closely tied to the firm's installed base, service know-how and garage-door systems knowledge, so accumulated learning should support further improvement rather than withdrawal.

The solid wood sectional garage door is still a weaker fit with the firm's metal-focused manufacturing base, but its shared door architecture, customization capability and access to residential dealers make it worth retaining as a niche offer.

The glazed industrial sectional door sits squarely within the firm's core industrial door competencies and regulatory knowledge, which gives it strong scope for ongoing refinement and commercialization.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door is highly consistent with the firm's strengths in thermal performance, industrial applications and compliant building solutions, so it has the strongest case for continuation.

Although technically close to the firm's core capabilities, this glazed industrial sectional door appears most exposed to portfolio rationalization because its value overlaps with other glazed industrial variants and resources can be used more effectively elsewhere.
